programs.name: Push-Up Progression
programs.description: Build chest, shoulder and triceps strength from the wall to a full push-up.

exercises.name: Wall Push-Up
exercises.description: The gentlest way to learn the push-up pattern.
steps: Stand an arm's length from a wall, hands at shoulder height.
Bend your elbows and lean your chest toward the wall.
Push back to the start with a straight body.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.description: Hands on a bench or table to lower the load.
steps: Place your hands on a stable raised surface.
Keep your body in one straight line.
Lower your chest to the edge, then press up.

exercises.name: Knee Push-Up
exercises.description: Full range of motion with less bodyweight.
steps: Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows at 45 degrees.
Press back up without sagging your hips.

exercises.name: Full Push-Up
exercises.description: The classic. Strict form, full range.
steps: Hands under shoulders, body in a straight line.
Lower until your chest nearly touches the floor.
Press up and fully extend your arms.

programs.name: Pull-Up Progression
programs.description: Develop your back and biceps on the way to your first pull-up.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
exercises.description: Build grip strength and get comfortable on the bar.
steps: Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Hang with your arms straight and shoulders engaged.
Breathe and hold.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.description: Horizontal pulling with a low bar.
steps: Lie under a low bar and grip it overhand.
Keep your body straight, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Negative Pull-Up
exercises.description: Lower slowly from the top to build pulling strength.
steps: Jump or step up so your chin is over the bar.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can.
Reset and repeat.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.description: Chin over the bar from a dead hang.
steps: Start from a dead hang with an overhand grip.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower under control to full extension.

programs.name: Squat Progression
programs.description: Strong legs and hips, from assisted squats to the pistol.

exercises.name: Assisted Squat
exercises.description: Hold a support to learn depth and balance.
steps: Hold a sturdy support at chest height.
Sit your hips back and down, chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.description: The foundation of every leg exercise.
steps: Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Stand up tall and squeeze your glutes.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.description: Single-leg strength and balance.
steps: Take a long step forward and stay there.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to rise.

programs.name: Core Progression
programs.description: Brace, hold and control. The base for every skill.

exercises.name: Knee Plank
exercises.description: Learn to brace your trunk.
steps: Forearms on the floor, knees down.
Squeeze your abs and glutes.
Hold a straight line from knees to head.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: The standard full-body brace.
steps: Forearms on the floor, legs straight.
Keep your hips level, don't let them sag.
Breathe steadily while you hold.

exercises.name: Hollow Hold
exercises.description: The gymnast's core position.
steps: Lie on your back, press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs a few inches.
Hold the shallow banana shape.

programs.name: Dip Progression
programs.description: Triceps and chest strength, from bench dips to parallel-bar dips.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
exercises.description: Feet on the floor, hands on a bench behind you.
steps: Sit on a bench, hands beside your hips, then slide off the edge.
Lower your body until your elbows reach about 90 degrees.
Press back up without shrugging your shoulders.

exercises.name: Support Hold
exercises.description: Learn to stay locked out on parallel bars.
steps: Grip the bars and press up with straight arms.
Push your shoulders down, away from your ears.
Hold steady, legs slightly forward.

exercises.name: Negative Dip
exercises.description: Lower slowly to build the strength to press back up.
steps: Start in the support position on the bars.
Lower yourself over 3 to 5 seconds.
Step or jump back up and repeat.

exercises.name: Parallel Bar Dip
exercises.description: Full range dip with control.
steps: Start in the support position.
Lower until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Press up to full lockout.

programs.name: Handstand Progression
programs.description: Balance and shoulder strength on the road to a freestanding handstand.

exercises.name: Pike Hold
exercises.description: Hips high, hands on the floor, feet on the ground.
steps: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet toward your hands.
Lift your hips high so your body forms an upside-down V.
Keep your arms straight and press the floor away.

exercises.name: Wall Walk
exercises.description: Walk your feet up the wall to get used to being upside down.
steps: Lie face down with your feet against the wall.
Push up and walk your feet up the wall as your hands walk back.
Go only as high as feels controlled, then walk back down.

exercises.name: Wall Handstand Hold
exercises.description: Stack your joints and hold against the wall.
steps: Kick up with your chest facing the wall.
Squeeze your legs, glutes and core into one straight line.
Push tall through your shoulders and breathe.
